subject.title: perf(models-config): unify auth-profile fingerprint cache + targetProvider short-circuit

question: After the synchronous contention defect is repaired, should this content/SQLite fingerprint plus provider-scoped structural shortcut become the canonical models-config routing trust boundary?
rationale: The shortcut intentionally decides when provider/auth discovery may be skipped and changes upgrade and restart behavior for persisted model state; code review can validate safety, but maintainers must accept that product and ownership boundary.

options.title: Adopt after repair
options.body: Accept the canonical fingerprint and scoped shortcut after contention is non-blocking and exact-head upgrade/runtime proof is supplied.

options.title: Warm cache only
options.body: Keep content-based warm-cache validation but remove the cold provider/model structural shortcut to reduce the trust boundary.

options.title: Decline the optimization
options.body: Retain current mtime planning behavior if the additional cache policy and maintenance cost are not worth the performance gain.

recommendation.title: Adopt after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the canonical fingerprint and scoped shortcut after contention is non-blocking and exact-head upgrade/runtime proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available owner-level routing signal for accepting a new auth/provider model-routing trust boundary.
